item.title: 13 Nov 2026: S&P 500 Dips 0.36% as Tech Drops and Yields Top 5%
item.description:
The S&P 500 slipped 0.36 percent on Friday but secured a 2.59 percent weekly gain as defensive sectors offset sharp technology sell-offs. Elevated Treasury yields above 5 percent pressured high-growth stocks, while Consumer Staples and Health Care led session gainers. Major corporate dealmaking and regulatory challenges across key sectors also shaped market activity.
In this episode: the market overview, the top story in each of the 11 sectors, and the week's key geopolitical developments.
